camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus --region cn-hangzhou --DeliveryType sls --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the log delivery switches for protocol logs and attack logs across sites. The delivery switch and the Simple Log Service (SLS) destination status represent different information. Query the destination and its availability status by calling DescribeDeliveryDestination
description_zh: 查询各站点的协议日志和攻击日志投递开关。投递开关与 SLS 目的地状态分别表示不同信息；目的地及其可用状态通过 DescribeDeliveryDestination 查询
name: DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus

parameters.help_en: The delivery type. Set this parameter to sls, which indicates delivery to SLS
parameters.help_zh: 投递类型，必须传入 sls，表示投递到日志服务 SLS
parameters.name: delivery_type

Data.description_en: The query result of log delivery switches
Data.description_zh: 日志投递开关查询结果

DeliveryType.description_en: The delivery type of this query. The current value is sls
DeliveryType.description_zh: 本次查询的投递类型，当前为 sls

StatusList.description_en: The list of log delivery switches for each site. An empty list is returned if log delivery is not activated
StatusList.description_zh: 各站点的日志投递开关列表；未开通日志投递时返回空列表

AttackLogStatus.description_en: The attack log delivery switch. A value of 0 indicates disabled. A value of 1 indicates enabled
AttackLogStatus.description_zh: 攻击日志投递开关。0 表示关闭，1 表示开启

DeliveryType.description_en: The delivery type of the site. The current value is sls
DeliveryType.description_zh: 该站点的投递类型，当前为 sls

ProtoLogStatus.description_en: The protocol log delivery switch. A value of 0 indicates disabled. A value of 1 indicates enabled
ProtoLogStatus.description_zh: 协议日志投递开关。0 表示关闭，1 表示开启

Site.description_en: The site identifier for log delivery. A value of global indicates unified delivery for a single site. Values cn, intl, and gov indicate the China site, international site, and Alibaba Gov Cloud site, respectively
Site.description_zh: 日志投递站点标识。global 表示单站点统一投递；cn、intl、gov 分别表示中国站、国际站和政务云站点

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request succeeds. The example shows a failure scenario
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示失败场景

Message.description_en: The result message of the request. This parameter describes the error cause when the request fails. The example shows a parameter validation failure scenario
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示参数校验失败场景

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
